svg.title: Genome Assembly Pipeline
svg.desc: gcl_genome_assembly (Nextflow DSL2): HiFi+Hi-C and Illumina short-read inputs, organelle branch on top, per-sample assembly spine, QC fan below, cross-sample Minigraph-Cactus pangenome stage on the right.
svg.text: PacBio HiFi + Hi-C (primary) · Illumina short-read (alternate) · haplotype-resolved, chromosome-scale · multi-sample pangenome · gcl_genome_assembly · Nextflow DSL2
no Hi-C: skip scaffolding (HiFi-only → teloclip; short-read → finalize)
SHORT-READ (ILLUMINA) — alternate assembler for samples without HiFi/Hi-C; contigs join the shared correction → scaffolding → finalization path
Two input modalities: HiFi+Hi-C drive hifiasm (rows 2-3); Illumina short-read drives SPAdes (row 4).
Organelle branch runs in parallel (MitoHiFi / GetOrganelle); its output filters organellar contigs.
Dashed borders = conditional steps (purging, correction, decontamination, teloclip).
Hi-C scaffolding (YaHS): up to 2 rounds; round 2 only if scaffold correction/decontam ran (else 1).
No Hi-C → scaffolding skipped (HiFi-only → teloclip; short-read → finalize).
QC at every stage → Summary report; all assemblies fan into one Minigraph-Cactus pangenome → report.
